comparison.objective: Install a spring tension rod level between cupboard walls at a marked height.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual compression, alignment, placement, and controlled release of a spring-loaded rod.
comparison.success_condition: Both caps press against the walls within height/level/square tolerances and the released rod supports itself for 4 seconds.
comparison.reason: Tests compliant interference installation and self-support, not agitation-driven size separation of loose bodies.
